landing.title: Turn the wish to help into real action
landing.subtitle: TIWIZI connects volunteers, organizations and companies. Join a campaign, check in with a QR code and follow your impact.

ecology.title: Ecology and environment
ecology.description: Beach, forest and neighborhood cleanups, recycling, tree planting. Results are shared to encourage others to join.

health.title: Health and emergency
health.description: Blood donation, first aid training, visits and moral support for patients, charity runs for people with cancer.

social.title: Social support
social.description: Food distributions, Ramadan actions, winter outreach, blankets, school renovation and upkeep of community places.

education.title: Education and tutoring
education.description: Free tutoring, BEM and BAC revision, literacy classes, internet basics for seniors.

skills.title: Skills and digital
skills.description: Programming, websites, design and translation for associations.

inclusion.title: Disability and inclusion
inclusion.description: Support for people with reduced mobility, adapted sport and wheelchair basketball, audio books for visually impaired people.

auth.title: Demo login
auth.subtitle: Pick an account to explore the platform. No password is required in this demo version.
